The main tradeoff between latency and throughput in online serving is that reducing latency generally increases throughput, and vice versa. To reduce latency, the system must process more requests per unit of time, thus increasing throughput. Masked diffusion decoding is particularly useful for generating long sequences of text, as it can capture the context of the entire sequence.
